open: Dana Reyes: Station Nine, this is town. Go ahead with your log.
closed: Dana Reyes: Logs keep for fourteen days. Call again at the next sked.
news: Dana: The Hundredmile herd was seen from the air north of the Barrens.
Dana: Pete says the Ninemile is running low and clear below the canyon.
Dana: Dr. Whitlock asks you to keep the weather post log through the week.
Dana: Fairbanks had a hard frost last night; the river villages are asking after you.
Lorraine Beck: Evening net. Salmon are late at the village; how are yours?
Dana: The program has booked the next drop. Keep the zone clear.

drop.plane_line: Pete Lund: Drop in two minutes. Stand clear of the zone.
drop.landed_line: A crate is down. Pete dips his wings and turns for town.
